name: Rehearsal C (thermal): system bracket between two CFRP frames next to an APU bay, invented card, not an official task
source: invented 2026-11-02 for docs/11 area C; data from research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/C_isil_enerji.md

limits._note: 150 C long-term service (invented); properties below are at 150 C

thermal._note: assembled at 20 C, runs at 150 C; both ends bolted to quasi-isotropic CFRP frames: T300/5208 [0/+-45/90]s 2.41e-6/K strain gauge, NASA TM-80788 Table 3 [D]; frames assumed to reach the same temperature

7075-T6.source: MMPDS-01: alpha Fig 3.7.6.0 (70-212 F) [D-fig]; E 90 % at 150 C Fig 3.7.6.1.4 [D-fig]; Fty 10,000 h at 150 C about 34 % of 483 (Fig 3.7.6.1.1(d)) [D-fig, Y]; over-ageing makes 7075 unfit for long exposure above about 100 C

2618-T61.source: MMPDS-01 Fig 3.2.13.0 alpha [D-fig]; E ~100 % at 150 C [D-fig]; Fty 1000 h at 200 C = 237 MPa used as a conservative proxy for long service at 150 C (95 % = 308 MPa after 1/2 h) [D-fig, Y]

AlSi10Mg.source: EOS M290: alpha 20e-6 (25-100 C) / 22e-6 (to 200 C) [D]; yield ratio 267/322 at 150 C interpolated from Cao 2021 Table 3 (298 at 100, 236 at 200) applied to Fty 220 [Y]; E 94 % taken from the 2024 curve [Y]

Ti-6Al-4V.source: MMPDS-01 Fig 5.4.1.0 alpha [D-fig]; E 91 % Fig 5.4.1.1.4 [D-fig]; Fty 79 % at 150 C Fig 5.4.1.1.1 applied to 827 [D-fig, Y]; wrought curves applied to AM [Y]

Inconel 718.source: EOS IN718 alpha 13.1e-6 (25-100 C) [D]; E 193 GPa at 300 F, SMC-045 Table 4 [D]; yield 1124 -> 1076 MPa (RT -> 316 C, SMC-045 Table 19) interpolated to 150 C and applied to 1145 [Y]
